beats.headline: AMZN Rises 3.8% Alongside 8-K Filing
beats.explanation: Amazon gained 3.81% to close at $249.02 on 2.1x average volume on the day it filed a Form 8-K. The upward move was shared with competitor NVDA, which rose 3.80%, while competitor INTC fell 2.10%.

beats.headline: AMZN Advances 3.5% as Competitors Rally
beats.explanation: Amazon rose 3.49% to $263.99 on 1.6x average volume without company-specific news. The advance was shared with competitors INTC and NVDA, which jumped 23.60% and 4.32%, respectively.

beats.headline: AMZN Falls 3.5% to $261.26
beats.explanation: Amazon fell 3.47% to close at $261.26 on 1.6x average volume with no company-specific news reported. The decline was shared with competitor INTC, which fell 4.67%, while competitor NVDA rose 6.26%.

beats.headline: AMZN Drops 3.1% in Peer Semiconductor Pullback
beats.explanation: Amazon fell 3.06% to $246.03 on 1.6x average volume without any company-specific announcements. The retreat was shared with competitors INTC and NVDA, which dropped 11.28% and 6.20%, respectively.

beats.headline: AMZN Declines 3.5% to $237.50
beats.explanation: Amazon dropped 3.46% to $237.50 on 1.3x average volume in the absence of company news. Competitor NVDA also moved lower by 1.33%, whereas competitor INTC gained 3.46%.

beats.headline: AMZN Drops 4.7% on Elevated Volume
beats.explanation: Shares fell 4.75% to $232.79 on 2.0x average volume with no news released. Competitor NVDA also dipped 0.97%, while competitor INTC moved opposite, climbing 5.19%.

beats.headline: AMZN Slips 3.1% to $227.01
beats.explanation: Amazon fell 3.10% to $227.01 on 2.3x average volume with no company-specific evidence provided. Competitor NVDA also dropped 1.64%, while competitor INTC rose 0.93%.

beats.headline: AMZN Rebounds 3.0% to $254.96
beats.explanation: Amazon gained 3.02% to $254.96 on 1.3x average volume without new filings or news. The advance was company-specific, as competitor NVDA rose only 0.33% and competitor INTC fell 4.43%.

beats.headline: AMZN Rises 3.9% Ahead of Quarterly Report
beats.explanation: Amazon gained 3.90% to $235.50 on 3.0x average volume as it filed a Form 8-K. The rise was shared with competitors INTC and NVDA, which rose 11.30% and 2.65%, respectively.

beats.headline: AMZN Surges 15.3% Following 10-Q and 8-K
beats.explanation: Amazon surged 15.32% to $271.58 on 3.8x average volume following the submission of its Form 10-Q and Form 8-K filings. The gain was company-specific, as competitor NVDA rose 2.93% while competitor INTC fell 1.02%.

beats.headline: AMZN Extends Surge by 4.6% to $284.02
beats.explanation: Amazon climbed 4.58% to $284.02 on 2.7x average volume in a continuation of post-filing momentum without new catalysts. Competitors also advanced, with NVDA up 2.93% and INTC up 0.89%.

beats.headline: AMZN Climbs 4.0% Against Competitor Drops
beats.explanation: Amazon gained 3.97% to $266.43 on 1.4x average volume with no company-specific news. The advance was company-specific, contrasting with drops in competitors NVDA (-4.58%) and INTC (-2.85%).

arc: Between April and August 2026, Amazon moved through a notable drawdown before staging a sharp quarterly filing-driven recovery. After climbing to $263.99 in late April, AMZN experienced multiple sharp retreats throughout June with no company-specific news, bottoming at $227.01 alongside mixed behavior across competitors INTC and NVDA. The decisive turning point arrived at the end of July, when Amazon filed a Form 8-K and Form 10-Q, driving a single-day 15.32% surge on 3.8x average volume and propelling the stock to a period high of $284.02 in early August.
